title: AI agents: verification policy for AI startups

template.description: A verification policy, not a security product. For AI startups whose agents act on accounts, data, credentials or billing. Catches an agent claiming a security or data action with no record (deleted, revoked, rotated, patched, disabled, restored, exported, granted, deployed, refunded), security and compliance assurances it must not give, guarantees, and prices or discounts that differ from yours. Deterministic and checked locally. It does not detect prompt injection, leaked secrets, paraphrased claims or attacks, and it does not encrypt, authenticate, patch or audit anything.
customize: Map each action to the operation your system records, so a real DONE record lets the claim pass.
Replace the sample prices with your own; the live checker then flags any discount or price for those items that you have not approved. Remove rules that do not apply.
Add the exact security and compliance phrases your agents must never say. Phrases are literal: a reworded claim is not caught.

forbid.why: Security assurances come from your security team, not the agent.
Only your compliance owner states compliance status.

phrases: no one can see your data
forbid.why: Data-handling promises come from your published privacy policy, not the agent.
